verdict.rationale: Mirrors lists integrations with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Pydantic AI, smolagents, Google ADK). It also says routing decisions run locally without a network request, which implies an in-process client library. However, no official SDK is named or documented, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or docs.md. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK with packages or languages, SDK reference documentation, an API spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against it.
